fields.tag: Unique identifier for the equipment or instrument
fields.equipment: The name or description of the industrial asset
fields.unit: The unit of measurement for the parameter
fields.action_remarks: Narrative description of the trigger condition and resulting action
fields.asset: The identifier or name of the asset involved
fields.condition: The prose stating when a rule or alarm is triggered
fields.response: The action required or caused by a trigger
fields.requirement: Specific mandates or tasks that must be performed
fields.role: The personnel role responsible for the action
fields.deadline: The time constraint for completing an action
fields.biogas_quality_interlock: Specific trigger conditions related to biogas quality
fields.alarm_designation: The priority or criticality level of the alarm
fields.interval: The frequency or schedule for a recurring task
fields.examples: Illustrative examples of the rule or limit
fields.probes: Identifiers for the specific probes used
fields.log_action: The specific entry to be recorded in a log
fields.reminder: The notification issued prior to a deadline
fields.logging: Instructions for recording results or actions
fields.classification: The category or type of space or asset
fields.test_window: The specific timeframe in which a test must occur
fields.ch4_limit: The safety limit for methane concentration
fields.h2s_limit: The safety limit for hydrogen sulfide concentration
fields.o2_limit: The safety limit for oxygen concentration
fields.restriction: Prohibitions or limitations on access or activity
fields.indicator: The visual or audible signal that activates
fields.exclusion_zone: The defined area where access is restricted
fields.personnel_entry_requirement: The authorization needed for personnel entry

categories.TriggeredResponse: Actions triggered by a specific event
categories.StaticLimitAndTriggeredResponse: Fixed limits paired with a resulting action
categories.AccessConstraint: Restrictions on entering or accessing an area
categories.StaticLimit: Fixed threshold values without a specified action
categories.AcknowledgmentRequirement: Rules regarding the confirmation of alarms
categories.ScheduledTask: Tasks performed on a recurring basis
categories.StartInterlock: Conditions that must be met to start equipment
categories.Classification: Categorization of the asset or environment
